title: Cinematic 3D animated chef cooking a stir-fry: seasoning, fast chopping…
content: Cinematic 3D animated chef cooking a stir-fry: seasoning, fast chopping, vegetables flying, wok flames, beautiful plating, final garnish, proud chef pose, and happy customer tasting the dish. Vibrant colors, smooth animation, dramatic lighting.

es.content: Chef animado en 3D cocinando un salteado: sazonando, cortando rápidamente, verduras volando, llamas del wok, emplatado hermoso, toque final de guarnición, pose orgullosa del chef y cliente feliz probando el plato. Colores vibrantes, animación fluida, iluminación dramática.

fr.content: Chef animé en 3D cinématique cuisinant un sauté : assaisonnement, découpe rapide, légumes en l'air, flammes du wok, belle présentation, garniture finale, pose fière du chef et client heureux goûtant le plat. Couleurs vibrantes, animation fluide, éclairage dramatique.

ja.content:
---
シネマティックな3Dアニメーションのシェフが炒め物を調理：調味、素早いチョッピング、飛び交う野菜、炎を上げる中華鍋、美しい盛り付け、最後のガーニッシュ、誇らしげなシェフのポーズ、そして料理を味わう幸せな顧客。鮮やかな色彩、滑らかなアニメーション、ドラマチックな照明。
---

ko.content: 시네마틱 3D 애니메이션 셰프가 볶음을 요리하는 장면: 양념, 빠른 채썰기, 날아다니는 채소, 웍의 불꽃, 아름다운 플레이팅, 마지막 장식, 자랑스러운 셰프 포즈, 그리고 요리를 맛보는 행복한 고객. 생생한 색감, 부드러운 애니메이션, 극적인 조명.

pt.content: Chef animado em 3D cinematográfico cozinhando um stir-fry: temperando, cortando rapidamente, vegetais voando, chamas no wok, bela apresentação, toque final, pose orgulhosa do chef e cliente feliz provando o prato. Cores vibrantes, animação suave, iluminação dramática.

zh.content: 电影级3D动画厨师炒菜：调味、快速切菜、蔬菜飞舞、锅中火焰、美丽摆盘、最后装饰、自豪的厨师姿势，以及满意的顾客品尝菜肴。色彩鲜艳、动画流畅、灯光效果戏剧化。
